profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Allstate
profile.summary: Team Leader and Software Engineer with extensive experience creating and executing innovative software solutions to enhance business productivity. Experienced in all aspects of the software development lifecycle and end-to-end project management. Vast experience leading technical teams with people management. Highly skilled at coordinating cross-functional teams in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
